paths.naming: Allegro INI sections include [disc], [sound], [video], [tape], [key_actions], [user_keyboard], and [joymap <device name>]

paths.path: The same b-em.cfg; key_actions and user_keyboard are persistent, while Allegro enumerates physical joysticks at runtime
paths.naming: joymap sections are matched by Allegro device name; the first two active devices are selected by runtime index, so no stable physical-id claim is made

paths.path: Attached guest media: .ssd/.dsd/.adf/.adl/.img/.fdi and .hdf; default IDE images are hd4.hdf and hd5.hdf in the config destination
paths.naming: Host image names are user-selected; guest file names are controlled by the BBC filing system

paths.path: User-selected snapshot path; Save State forces the .snp extension
paths.naming: BEMSNAP3 header (versions 1–3 load); no numbered slot files
